title: AI Lead Qualification Engine
summary: A Tally intake flow routes new inquiries into n8n, where OpenAI classifies the lead, assigns buying intent, and triggers the right next step in Google Sheets and Gmail.

title: AI Lead Routing + Scoring
summary: Raw lead data is normalized, scored, and passed through a decision layer so the sales process focuses on the most promising opportunities instead of manual sorting.

title: AI Support Triage Assistant
summary: Telegram conversations are handled by an AI assistant that answers common questions, gathers missing customer details, creates tickets, and sends confirmation emails automatically.

title: Batch AI Processing + Messaging
summary: Spreadsheet rows are looped through an AI model, transformed into usable output, and then routed into notifications and follow-ups for faster execution at scale.

title: Instagram DM AI Auto-Reply
summary: Incoming Instagram DMs are parsed, filtered for text, analyzed by AI, and automatically replied to with quick, conversational responses while non-text messages are logged for follow-up.
